messages:
maria: FYI - new HW partner EdgeBox Systems wants per-minute metering, but devices will often upload offline batches up to 48h late. We need device_id -> customer mapping, SKU names, signature verification, and a reconciliation playbook. Any immediate blockers?

 dave: We can accept late batches. Main asks: strong idempotency on batch_id & event_id, and documented TTL for dedupe. Also need clear error codes for bad signature vs malformed payload.

 li: On SKU naming they propose: `edge_minutes_v2` (consumption) and `edge_seat_license` (entitlement). Sample batch payload (they'll gzip and POST):

 ```
 {
   "batch_id": "c2f1e6a2-...",
   "org_id": "org-987",
   "device_id": "edge-01-xy",
   "events": [
     {"event_id":"evt-100","device_ts":"2026-03-18T16:05:12+02:00","seconds":90},
     {"event_id":"evt-101","device_ts":"2026-03-18T16:10:00+02:00","seconds":300}
   ],
   "seat_count": 3,
   "signature": "sha256=base64sig..."
 }
 ```

 li: They can send up to 15k events per batch grouped by device. They also include an HMAC using a shared secret.

 jen: Two policy points: 1) attribution when plan changes mid-window - do we attribute by event time or invoice period? 2) timezone handling - partner reports local tz offsets.

 maria: My proposal: convert `device_ts` to UTC on ingest and attribute consumption to the plan in effect at event time (prorate if a plan change crosses the event timestamp). Billing granularity: round up to nearest whole minute for chargeable units; persist raw seconds in audit trails and UI diffs.

 dave: Fine with event-time attribution. Dedupe TTLs: staging 14 days, prod 90 days. Signature failures => 401, malformed payload => 400, duplicate batch => 200 with body {"ignored":true, "reason":"duplicate_batch"}. We'll also surface a small ingestion metrics dashboard.

 li: Test harness - ask EdgeBox to POST to staging `/v1/marketplace/partner-usage` with staging key header `X-Partner-Key`. Example cURL: 

 ```
 curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/marketplace/partner-usage \
   -H "X-Partner-Key: sbx-edge-xxxx" \
   -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   --data-binary @edgebox_batch.json.gz
 ```

 jen: Reconciliation: nightly job compares aggregated minutes from partner batches vs our derived per-customer aggregation and any device counters they expose. Alert if >3% variance for a rolling 7-day window or a single-day spike >10%. Create console alert and slack incident channel when triggered.

 maria: Operational detail: late-arriving batches mark affected UTC invoice windows as "dirty". Re-aggregation runs automatically and creates an audit-entry describing delta (old vs new) and a flag if invoice affected. Manual rollback should require ops approval. We'll need a runbook.

 dave: Entitlements: `seat_count` updates entitlement table immediately (no backfill). Consumption is backfilled. For idempotency, accept `event_id` dedupe across batches and per-device monotonic sequence if provided.

 li: I'll add optional fields to make reconciliation deterministic: `plan_id` and `plan_effective_at` on batch (they may supply it). We'll fail ingestion if `org_id` doesn't map to an active customer in staging.

 billing-bot: Sandbox created: org `edgebox-sbx-001`, sandbox plan `edgebox-staging-30d`. Staging API key `sbx-edge-ALPHA`. :white_check_mark: 

 maria: Next steps: li - update partner contract + example payloads; dave - implement signature checks, dedupe TTLs, and response semantics; jen - add reconciliation alerts + runbook for late reprocessing; I'll schedule onboarding call and secret exchange with EdgeBox for Tue 10am PT. We'll do a verification run after they push 3 sample batches. :thumbsup:
